source_evidence: Player exact 'Roll for me until I say stop' grants standing delegation of V dice only, not choices/speech/limited expenditure, until revoked. Prior player directive group around horses, hold attacks until melee, Mara deep in carriage, V Ready for peryton entering melee with ally, continued through two rounds. Correction disclosed before any turns: prior recorded NPC initiative faces 16/5/4 were erroneously claimed to be executed; they were not generated, therefore invalid, not an alternate accepted actual RNG; replace explicitly before dependent combat. Genuine container Python secrets d20 V11+4+attuned Luckstone1=16, perytons shared6+1=7, Cirren5+2=7, Fenar13+2=15, Mara20 (temporary ordinary noncombatant +0, no exact stat block established). DM resolves tie Cirren first. No surprise. Mara retreats deep inside coach and stays out of sight; no Hide check or invented guaranteed cover vs all angles. Four horses remain harnessed stationary. R1 V moves to (10,-5,0) and Ready normal dart (+9, 20/60 range, unlimited ammunition, visually silver sword, physical not native psychic blade under standing rule) when peryton within5ft of ally. Fenar moves (20,5,0), BA Rage4→3 Beast Claws magical via Bestial Soul, Ready one claw; Cirren moves (10,5,0), Ready Toll the Dead cantrip (concentration). No Reckless Attack on readied reaction off own turn. Perytons Dash approaching exposed humanoids, P1 targeting Fenar, P2 V, P3 Cirren; end respectively 40,~47,40ft from target in air, sufficient to dive on next turn, within 120ft movement, no attack or trigger R1. R2 renew standing V Ready dart (previous expires unused); Fenar BA Shift3→2 gains6THP, no available melee target for included bite, readies one magical claw; Cirren renews readied Toll the Dead, no slots used. P1 flies straight 35ft toward Fenar to within5ft, triggers V dart Sneak Attack (Fenar adjacent, normal range, no disadvantage) and Fenar claw and Cirren cantrip. Genuine executed Python secrets V d20face11+9=20 hit AC13; d4face4+Dex4+Sneak2d6faces5,4=17 piercing halved8 due to resistance, P1 33→25. Fenar d20face6+8=14 hit AC13; magical Beast claw d6face6+STR5+Rage2=13 slashing, P1 25→12; Cirren Toll WIS save d20face15+1=16 vsDC16 success no damage, concentration ends. All three reactions expended in R2, V refreshes at own R3 start. P1 Dive Attack qualifies >=30ft straight toward Fenar, Gore d20face8+5=13 miss AC14; Talons d20face17+5=22 hit, 2d4faces3,3+3+2d8faces5,3=17 piercing halved8 by Rage, THP6 absorbed, HP59→57. P2 flies ~42ft straight to V; Gore d20face3+5=8 miss, Talons face8+5=13 miss AC19; P3 flies35ft to Cirren, Gore face10+5=15 miss, Talons face7+5=12 miss AC18. Each flies back up using remaining movement and Flyby, no OAs. P1 and P3 approx30ft above own ground target, P2 approx23ft above V; all alive. No extra creature turns or attacks. Mara and horses healthy. Round3 V turn pending, no new V actions beyond standing Ready R1/R2. Fenar Rage and Shift active, MP6/6, HP57/59 no THP; Cirren51/51 all slots/CD full, no concentration. V48/48 all pools full, no MP/psi/Sup etc. LongRest1→0/6 due actual damage and Rage/Shift; time about12sec, Day308~10:20. Purse391gp9sp6cp food21/feed28 sealed PixieDust1, all custody/route unchanged. Prior erroneously reported V speech was not user-specified and not canon; tactical order only.
pending_action: Day308~10:20 R3 V turn start, V dice delegated until stop. Initiative Mara20 noncombatant, V16, Fenar15, Cirren7 before perytons7 shared. V(10,-5,0) 48/48 AC19, action BA movement reaction available at R3 start; Fenar(20,5,0)57/59 AC14 Rage3/4 active claws magic, Shift2/3 active THP0, MP6/6 reaction used until own turn; Cirren(10,5,0)51/51 AC18 all slots4/3/3 CD2/2 reaction used until own turn, no concentration. P1 12/33 approx(20,5,30), P2 33/33 approx(10,-5,23), P3 33/33 approx(10,5,30), AC13, fly60, Flyby, nonmagic B/P/S resist; airborne, no OAs on departure, initial R2 attacks completed. Mara inside coach, horses harnessed and unharmed. V HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1, cloak+luckstone attuned. LongRest0/6 reset, food21/feed28, purse391gp9sp6cp, Pixie Dust1; no resource change beyond Fenar and rest. Exact next V R3 choice, not auto-renew beyond resolved turns. Day308 encounter used, Day309 mandatory quiet random. All quest/custody unchanged.
